Lukas.knows: You know Kira as your bandmate and vocalist, and you have worked together for about four years. You know Jonas as your bandmate on bass, and you have shared a rehearsal room with him for the same stretch.
Lukas.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly when there is something about the band to sort out.
Lukas.style: Uses a few emoji and some common abbreviations.

Kira.knows: You know Lukas as your bandmate on guitar, and you have worked together for about four years. You know Jonas as your bandmate on bass, and the three of you have played together since the band started.
Kira.texts: You message the group mostly when someone else has started a conversation, and you rarely start one yourself.
Kira.style: Uses a few emoji and some common abbreviations.

Jonas.knows: You know Lukas as your bandmate on guitar, and you have played with him for about four years. You know Kira as your bandmate and vocalist, and the three of you have played together since the band started.
Jonas.texts: You message the group now and then, usually to confirm plans or answer something someone asked.
Jonas.style: Uses a few emoji and some common abbreviations.

private_lines.Lukas: You teach guitar and music theory to students in Zurich, and most of your days are lessons, with prep and admin in between. You live alone in a flat in the city and get to rehearsal by tram.
private_lines.Kira: You work as an agent at a call centre in Zurich, taking customer calls on shifts that rotate through the week. You live alone in a small flat and fit band practice and gigs around your shifts.
private_lines.Jonas: You work as an electrician, mostly on installation and repair jobs around Zurich, so you start early and finish by the afternoon. You live alone in a flat across the city and get to rehearsal on your bike.
